title: Refusal
description: The body of a refusal the control plane answers an adapter's request with, application/json. The codes an adapter meets: 401 unauthorized, one uniform unsigned answer for everything about who is asking: a missing signature, or one that is not 64 bytes of strict base64url; a well-formed signature that fails to verify, an S at or above the group order included; a missing or malformed access key id; an unknown or revoked access key, or a key of another kind; a GET's X-Qory-Timestamp that is missing, not a decimal integer, or more than 300 seconds from the control plane's clock, either way; a POST's time more than 300 seconds from it, either way; and a replay, a request whose signature it has already seen, under the replay rule of definitions.schema.json. It tells the adapter nothing about which cause applied, and an adapter never takes it as the access key being revoked; 403 forbidden, a request outside the access key's rights; 400 bad_request, for two causes alone: a signing header sent twice, X-Qory-Access-Key-Id, X-Qory-Instance-Id, X-Qory-Signature-Ed25519 or X-Qory-Timestamp, or an X-Qory-Instance-Id that is absent or outside its pattern; 400 unsupported_contract_version, an X-Qory-Contract-Version that is missing, sent twice, not a decimal integer, or a revision the control plane does not serve; 400 invalid_request, a body that breaks its schema; 404 not_found, a route the control plane does not serve; 413 payload_too_large, a request over 1 MiB; 415 unsupported_media_type, a request that is not application/json; 409 collection_not_linked, items of a collection that is not linked to a workspace; 429 rate_limited, with Retry-After, the seconds the adapter waits before it sends the request again, built anew, as definitions.schema.json describes a retry. A 401 is always unsigned. A 413, 415 or 400 bad_request may be unsigned, because the control plane may decide them before it verifies the request's signature. Every other answer is signed, and an adapter acts on no other unsigned answer. A signed answer is signed as definitions.schema.json describes. A member this schema does not define is refused.
